hooks.excerpt: All interactions are done by using cards or combining them together.

hooks.text: 自主生态模拟动物植物种群、四季与天气
hooks.excerpt: A Living Forest Ecosystem: Engage with a complex ecosystem featuring dynamically simulated forces (including animal and plant populations) that operate autonomously yet can be meaningfully influenced by your actions. Experience the cyclical nature of life through four distinct seasons and a full weather system.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 消化免疫、伤口与精神状态的细粒度角色模拟
hooks.excerpt: Realistic Character Simulation: Simulating the digestive and immune systems, detailed wounds and healing processes, and a mental health model that includes anxiety, mania, depression and altered mind states. Tracking everything from body weight, to calluses, stool consistency and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
